title: Cardinal Billing Account Installment Charge by Premium Portion and Last Installment
content:
**Rule.** How the installment charge on a Cardinal Billing Account installment invoice is computed depends on the installment being invoiced: when its premium portion is under $175.00, the charge is the state installment charge multiplied by the premium portion and divided by $175.00; when it is the last installment of the term and its premium portion is $175.00 or more, the charge is one half (0.5) of the state installment charge; otherwise the charge is the state installment charge itself.

The installment being invoiced is the last installment of the term when it is the only installment of the term not yet invoiced, every other installment of the term (the down payment included) already having been invoiced. Its premium portion is the premium amount of the invoice being issued.

## Decision matrix

| Premium portion | Last installment of the term | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Under $175.00 | Yes or No | State installment charge multiplied by the premium portion, divided by $175.00 |
| $175.00 or more | Yes | One half of the state installment charge |
| $175.00 or more | No | State installment charge itself |

## Worked figures (hypothetical state installment charge $6.00)

| Premium portion | Last installment | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| $140.00 | No | $6.00 multiplied by $140.00, divided by $175.00, that is $4.80 |
| $174.99 | Yes | $6.00 multiplied by $174.99, divided by $175.00, that is $5.99966 |
| $175.00 | Yes | $3.00 |
| $175.00 | No | $6.00 |
| $260.00 | No | $6.00 |
